sources.snippet: Qwen3.8-27B is out: Apache 2.0, a surprise vision encoder, and 262k context. Which quant fits your VRAM, the Ollama and GGUF routes, and how to be generating tokens today.

sources.title: Qwen3.8-27B · LLM Releases
sources.snippet: The open-weight, single-GPU sibling of Qwen3.8-Max, published by Alibaba on Hugging Face on Aug 14 2026 under Apache 2.0 — the smaller open release Alibaba had promised alongside the closed Qwen3.8-Max flagship. A 27B dense model (~28B counting the ~1B vision encoder) with 64 layers, hidden size 5,120, and a 248,320-token vocabulary.

sources.title: Qwen3.8 - How to Run Locally | Unsloth Documentation
sources.snippet: Qwen3.8 is Qwen's new model family, featuring Qwen3.8- 27B, Qwen3.8- 2.4T-A95B and Qwen3.8- Max. Qwen3.8-27B has vision and reasoning capabilities, a 256K context window, and runs locally on 17GB RAM/VRAM setups. Qwen3.8 excels at agentic coding, vision and chat tasks, and can now run via Unsloth GGUFs, NVFP4 and Unsloth Desktop.
